description: Atlarium helps users explore public habitat data for aquariums and related habitat systems in ChatGPT. It can search species, plants, products, guides, diagnostics, medicines and fertilization references; check compatibility; calculate tank, water chemistry, dosing and equipment estimates; and generate advisory tank and fertilization plans. The app is read-only and does not expose Atlarium accounts, private workspaces, admin APIs or write operations.
